column3: One lazy-load helper set in lib/ui-sdk-lazy.ts serves the sidebar, the composer and the Threads/Captains toggle: warmUiSdk(...names), replayWhenReady(names, event) and loadOnIntent(...names) built on them; #70's loadOnIntent now holds one press per control and catches failed loads, and the toggle replays a press made before Segmented Control registers
column4: XIN-23 on #97: if the Segmented Control chunk aborted after the mount warm, the toggle stayed dead for the session, and presses while it was slow were dropped; #70's loadOnIntent replayed every early click and left a rejected promise on abort
column5: sidebar.test.ts aborted-chunk and slow-chunk toggle tests fail with the toggle replay removed and pass with it; sidebar and composer e2e green
